content.short: CodeHound by CyberSanctus automatically scans smart contracts for vulnerabilities and potential exploits, using AI to enhance security checks and speed audits.
content.description: CodeHound solves the problem of insecure smart contracts by automatically scanning for vulnerabilities and potential exploits. It reduces human error and accelerates the audit process, enabling developers to identify and fix issues before they become critical. By applying AI to analyze code, CodeHound delivers more comprehensive security checks, catching problems that traditional methods might miss. This helps protect projects from costly breaches and strengthens trust in decentralized applications.
content.meta: CodeHound is a Web3 security solution. Discover CodeHound and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
